subject: Alder river otter

initialCheckpoint.status: immutable first self-approved submission; parent rejected the seated support claim and transform contract

parentFindings.finding: Seated wash had a horizontal unsupported belly and raised rump/tail, with both front paws lifted; front recording concealed the support failure. Forearm fold was compressed.
parentFindings.repair: Saved groom keys now form a low three-paw cheek wash: fore.R and both hind paws support the trunk; fore.L reaches the lowered turned cheek, makes two gentle strokes and returns to standing. Label and support/cheek/wash/lower markers describe the new action.
parentFindings.ownerRefinement: First repair attempt reached too far forward/up and stretched the forearm into a flat shape in opposite-side detail. Shortened reach from x=.46/z=.55 to x=.32/z=.43 and increased head lowering from .21 to .32 rad. Adopted candidate-02; no sculpt or weight change.
parentFindings.ownerJudgment: Both opposite side/three-quarter lift, two strokes and recovery retain a low supported trunk and rounded arm. Side consumer exposes the stable support; opposite three-quarter exposes the washing fore.L.
parentFindings.parentReinspection: Parent reported final native transition views and live side/orbit/one-shot six-second recovery acceptable at the established stylized quality bar; F1 resolved.

parentFindings.finding: Object translation changed world geometry while the inherited local-coordinate digest/support/clearance method falsely accepted it.
parentFindings.origin: uncovered shared-method weakness inherited from earlier exporter code; not evidence that this trial alone invented the bug
parentFindings.repair: Geometry digest v2 includes object/parent transforms and named weight bindings. Fitting/export explicitly require identity object, parent-inverse and scene transforms; export checks every authored frame. Evaluated sole and whole-surface probes use matrix_world, plus scene trajectory once. Rejections name the object/matrix and explain copied-master apply/restore-support/refit/review steps.
parentFindings.ownerProof: Four disposable faults rejected: translated paw +.05 and hide -1, both before and after applying transforms into mesh. All four change the digest. Valid saved source exports; authoritative masters remain unchanged.
parentFindings.parentReinspection: Independent parent +.05 paw and -.5 hide faults rejected; digest changes detected and canonical bytes unchanged. F2 resolved.

verdict: Self-approved bounded repairs; parent reinspection resolves both findings. Required completion gates are recorded separately. This record does not replace or revise the frozen initial self-review.
sourceTransformContract: identity object, parent inverse and scene transforms

reviewCoverage.native: Final saved adopted candidate, clay/material review output at frames 60,138,204,324 and enlarged frame156. Both sides and both three-quarter directions available; selected opposite views retained at full 1200x840 as JPEG quality2.
reviewCoverage.consumer: Fresh functional browser journey exercises all five clips and records actual unretimed 1x canvas playback. Repaired groom additionally recorded in Clay Side and opposite three-quarter, plus Front Material. Three original movies retained, decoded at 8 Hz into cropped phase sheets. Read six columns left to right, then down; tile index / 8 is recording time, black tail tiles are empty. Crop 600x320 at x340/y150 from 1308x560 encoded canvas, scaled to420x224 per tile; crop enlarges the recorded subject without retiming.
reviewCoverage.judgmentMethod: Owner inspected native enlarged clay, browser scrubs and dense phases decoded from actual 1x recordings. Parent also performed live browser playback/orbit inspection.
reviewCoverage.phone: 390x844 full consumer capture, no horizontal overflow
reviewCoverage.nativeEdit: Saved scent head key frame150 +.12 rad on copied masters, save/reload/fit/export and fresh 12 Hz endpoint-inclusive samples, 16 vertices per mesh. Original and edited browser deformation agreement.
reviewCoverage.transforms: Four actual disposable native save/reload/export fault probes plus valid saved-source export; thresholds unchanged.
